notes_for_next_run: Ad placement lesson (2026-07-24): the ad network caps how many opportunities can be in 'accepted' status at once. Placing fresh ad OFFERS via save_post triggers new acceptances and fails with 'can not accept any more opportunities' when the cap is full. The fix is to call list_ad_opportunities, take the already-'accepted' opportunities (discarding any whose send_by is at/before the target send time), rank by payout_per_click_cents, and embed those opportunity IDs directly in the advertisementOpportunity node. This run filled all 3 slots that way (Tello 225c, Q3 Advisors 225c, True Gold Republic 187c), which also outpaid the raw offers on the board (150-187c).
